steps: Wash the okra, pat it completely dry, cut off the ends and slice it into short pieces.
Fry the okra in half the oil on medium heat, stirring often, for 7 to 10 minutes until it is no longer sticky. Set it aside.
Heat the rest of the oil on medium, add the cumin and, when it splutters, fry the onion and green chilli until golden.
Stir in the ginger and garlic for about 2 minutes, until the raw smell goes.
Add the tomato and salt and cook for about 4 minutes, until soft and mushy.
Stir in the turmeric, chilli powder, coriander powder and garam masala with about 2 tablespoons water a person, and cook until thick.
Fold in the okra and crushed kasuri methi and cook uncovered on low for about 5 minutes, until the okra is tender.
Scatter the coriander leaves on top and serve.
note: The sources use 85 to 125 g of okra a person; 100 g sits in the middle. Garlic is light because only one source uses it.
